item.title: Dear Abby: Man likes the feel of silk on skin
item.description: DEAR ABBY: Since I was a small boy, silk fabric has always made me feel “safe.” I remember wearing tights in the bathroom in front of the mirror or under my pajamas.

item.title: Pet Talk: When puppy gets into the pills
item.description: Texas A&M photo Dr. Lance Wheeler examines a four-legged patient. Our furry friends have curious natures, and even though we try our best to keep them safe and healthy, they may still get into trouble if they unknowingly eat medications that are toxic to them.
